invites_expected_phone_active_uq.name: invites_expected_phone_active_uq
invites_expected_phone_active_uq.where: "invites"."kind" = 'whatsapp' and "invites"."consumed_at" is null and "invites"."revoked_at" is null

invites_kind_fields.name: invites_kind_fields
invites_kind_fields.value:
("invites"."kind" = 'email' and "invites"."email" is not null and "invites"."expected_phone" is null)
    or ("invites"."kind" = 'whatsapp' and coalesce("invites"."expected_phone" ~ '^[0-9]{10,15}$', false) and coalesce("invites"."code_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$', false))

members_active_needs_auth.name: members_active_needs_auth
members_active_needs_auth.value: "members"."access_state" <> 'active' or ("members"."appwrite_user_id" is not null and "members"."email" is not null and "members"."email_confirmed_at" is not null)

members_auth_only_active.name: members_auth_only_active
members_auth_only_active.value: "members"."access_state" = 'active' or ("members"."appwrite_user_id" is null and "members"."email_confirmed_at" is null)

treatment_phases_schedule.name: treatment_phases_schedule
treatment_phases_schedule.value:
("treatment_phases"."schedule_type" = 'interval' and coalesce("treatment_phases"."interval_hours" > 0, false) and "treatment_phases"."first_dose_time" is not null)
    or ("treatment_phases"."schedule_type" = 'fixed_times' and coalesce(array_length("treatment_phases"."times", 1), 0) > 0)
